description: Trip-level passenger counts from automatic passenger counters (APC): boardings, alightings, peak on-board load. One row per operated trip on an APC-equipped vehicle. Split by month.

columns.name: vehicle_id
columns.description: Vehicle whose APC produced the count

columns.name: boardings
columns.description: Passengers who boarded during the trip (all fare types)

columns.name: alightings
columns.description: Passengers who alighted (APC sensor, small counting noise)

columns.name: max_load
columns.description: Highest number of passengers on board at once

columns.name: denied_boardings
columns.description: Passengers left behind because the bus was full

columns.name: card_taps
columns.description: Smart-card validations recorded by the on-board validator (should equal ticket rows for the trip)
